description: This is a PHP source file that generates an HTML page for managing port management rules in a network device. It includes server-side logic to construct rule data and client-side JavaScript for user interactions such as enabling/disabling rules, deleting, and changing rule types.

methods.name: ondelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a port management rule via AJAX.

methods.name: onenable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific port management rule via AJAX.

methods.name: ondisableAll
methods.description: Disables or enables all port management rules via AJAX.

methods.name: onchangeRuleType
methods.description: Changes the rule type (white/black) via AJAX.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for UI controls such as checkboxes and buttons.

methods.name: onchangePmDisable
methods.description: Enables or disables the port management UI controls based on the disable checkbox state.

methods.name: initPmFields
methods.description: Populates the port management rules table and initializes UI state.
